query_coordinates: 0-based chr1 bases; every codec returns the same 16384 sequence bytes; original FASTA preserved in archives
latency: library call plus FASTA newline removal; excludes initialization, file loading, oracle verification, output serialization and caller buffer allocation
archives: bgzip anonymous Linux memfd; ACEAPEX and zstd malloc buffers; all populated before timing
decoder_state: one initialized handle per codec, reused across warmup and all 200 queries
amplification: final-output-layer reconstructed FASTA bytes / requested sequence bytes; excludes intermediate ACEAPEX entropy-stream buffers; not a measure of total memory traffic

amplification_evidence.aceapex: derived exact reconstructed block span from pinned decoder and actual archive header

gpu: n/a: no GPU adapter in stage 1
